"""One-time terminal evidence collection; reuse every successful cached read."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from collect_reference_r02_startup import config_equal
from terminal_worker_identity import reconcile_worker

R = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
E = R.parent / 'ema-gram-reference-seed0-r02-20261107'
C = 'ema-gram-20-reference-seed0-r02-20261107'
SOURCE = '6ec7fa98b842cdff03b46986d00e3ee4dc735615'
ROOT = R / 'scratch/20261107-reference-r02-completion'
START = R / 'scratch/20261107-reference-r02-startup'


def save(p, obj):
    with p.open('x') as f:
        json.dump(obj, f, indent=2)
        f.write('\n')


def main():
    ROOT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    obs = json.loads((E / f'scratch/{C}-observers.json').read_text())
    row = obs['jobs']['0']
    job = row['last_successful_snapshot']['job']
    assert row['terminal'] and job['state'] == 'JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED'
    assert job['exit_code'] == job['failure_count'] == job['preemption_count'] == 0
    assert job['task_count'] == job['completed_count'] == job['task_state_counts']['succeeded'] == 4
    assert obs['binding']['source'] == SOURCE and obs['owner_pid'] == row['owner_pid'] == 27858
    assert row['follow_pid'] == 28032
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=E, text=True).strip() == SOURCE
    for path, digest in obs['binding']['inputs'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((E / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
    startup = json.loads((START / 'validated.json').read_text())
    assert startup['passed'] and startup['source'] == SOURCE
    if not (ROOT / 'canonical.json').exists():
        save(ROOT / 'canonical.json', obs)
    for i, prior in enumerate(startup['tasks']):
        tid = row['job_id'] + '/' + str(i)
        assert prior['task_id'] == tid
        p = ROOT / f'task-{i}.json'
        if not p.exists():
            save(ROOT / f'task-{i}.started.json', dict(task_id=tid, source=SOURCE, utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat()))
            result = subprocess.run(['uv', 'run', '--no-sync', 'iris', '--cluster=marin', 'rpc', 'controller', 'get-task-status', '--task-id', tid], cwd=E, capture_output=True, text=True)
            save(ROOT / f'task-{i}.raw.json', dict(returncode=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr))
            assert result.returncode == 0
            save(p, json.loads(result.stdout))
        task = json.loads(p.read_text())['task']
        assert task['task_id'] == tid and task['current_attempt_id'] == 0 and len(task['attempts']) == 1
        attempt = task['attempts'][0]
        assert task['state'] == attempt['state'] == 'TASK_STATE_SUCCEEDED'
        assert task['exit_code'] == attempt['exit_code'] == attempt['attempt_id'] == 0
        assert attempt['attempt_uid'] == prior['attempts'][0]['attempt_uid']
        assert attempt['started_at'] == prior['attempts'][0]['started_at'] and not attempt['is_worker_failure']
        proof = reconcile_worker(task, dict(worker_id=prior['worker_id'], attempt_uid=attempt['attempt_uid'], evidence=str(START / f'task-{i}.json')))
        if not (ROOT / f'worker-{i}.json').exists():
            save(ROOT / f'worker-{i}.json', proof)
        print(json.dumps(dict(task=i, archive=attempt['output_archive'])), flush=True)
    import wandb
    api = None
    for i, join in startup['joins'].items():
        identity = join['native'][0]
        p = START / f'finished-native-{identity}.json'
        if not p.exists():
            save(ROOT / f'native-{i}.started.json', dict(identity=identity, source=SOURCE))
            if api is None:
                api = wandb.Api()
            remote = api.run('marin-community/marin/' + identity)
            run = dict(id=remote.id, state=remote.state, config=dict(remote.config), summary=dict(remote.summary), url=remote.url)
            save(ROOT / f'native-{i}.raw.json', run)
            assert run['state'] in ('finished', 'failed', 'crashed', 'killed')
            save(p, run)
        run = json.loads(p.read_text())
        assert run['id'] == identity and run['state'] == 'finished' and run['summary']['probe/success'] == 1
        config_equal(run['config'], startup['runs'][identity]['config'])
        print(json.dumps(dict(task=i, native=identity, state=run['state'], summary=run['summary'])), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Collect bounded terminal task archives and generation-bound diagnostic artifacts."""
import hashlib
import io
import json
import tarfile
from pathlib import PurePosixPath
import zstandard
from google.cloud import storage
from collect_reference_r02_terminal import ROOT, START, C, SOURCE, save

startup = json.loads((START / 'validated.json').read_text())
client = None
for i in range(4):
    task = json.loads((ROOT / f'task-{i}.json').read_text())['task']
    attempt = task['attempts'][0]
    archive = attempt['output_archive']
    uri = f"gs://marin-us-central2/tmp/ttl=7d/iris/task-outputs/kaiyuew@stanford.edu/{C}-00/{i}/{attempt['attempt_uid']}/outputs.tar.zst"
    assert archive['uri'] == uri and archive['state'] == 'TASK_OUTPUT_ARCHIVE_STATE_UPLOADED'
    assert 0 < int(archive['size_bytes']) < 2_000_000
    directory = ROOT / f'task-{i}'
    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    p = directory / 'outputs.tar.zst'
    if not p.exists():
        save(directory / 'archive.started.json', dict(uri=uri, sha256=archive['sha256']))
        if client is None:
            client = storage.Client()
        blob = client.bucket('marin-us-central2').blob(uri.split('/', 3)[3])
        blob.reload()
        assert blob.size == int(archive['size_bytes'])
        data = blob.download_as_bytes(if_generation_match=int(blob.generation), checksum='crc32c')
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == archive['sha256']
        with p.open('xb') as f:
            f.write(data)
        save(directory / 'archive-receipt.json', dict(uri=uri, generation=int(blob.generation), sha256=archive['sha256'], size=len(data)))
    assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == archive['sha256']
    with zstandard.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(p.read_bytes())) as reader:
        raw = reader.read(8_000_001)
    assert len(raw) <= 8_000_000
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw), mode='r:') as tf:
        members = [m for m in tf.getmembers() if m.isfile()]
        assert all(m.size < 2_000_000 for m in members)
        if not (directory / 'archive-members.json').exists():
            save(directory / 'archive-members.json', [dict(name=m.name, size=m.size) for m in members])
        manifests = [m for m in members if PurePosixPath(m.name).name == 'upload-manifest.json']
        assert len(manifests) == 1
        member = manifests[0]
        base = PurePosixPath(member.name).parent
        uuid = base.name
        assert len(uuid) == 32 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in uuid)
        manifest_bytes = tf.extractfile(member).read()
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_bytes)
        assert manifest['success'] is True and manifest['source_commit'] == SOURCE
        assert manifest['task'] == task['task_id'] + ':0' and manifest['attempt_uid'] == attempt['attempt_uid']
        artifact_paths = ['attempt.json']
        join = startup['joins'][str(i)]
        artifact_paths += [join['host'][0] + '/config.json']
        artifact_paths += [join['native'][0] + '/' + name for name in ('config.json', 'report.json', 'loss-rows.jsonl')]
        assert sorted(x['path'] for x in manifest['artifacts']) == sorted(artifact_paths)
        for relative in artifact_paths + ['upload-manifest.json']:
            matches = [m for m in members if PurePosixPath(m.name) == base / relative]
            assert len(matches) == 1
            data = tf.extractfile(matches[0]).read()
            dest = directory / relative
            dest.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            if dest.exists():
                assert dest.read_bytes() == data
            else:
                with dest.open('xb') as f:
                    f.write(data)
            # Read back each bounded permanent artifact, bound to the wrapper's saved generation.
            record = next((x for x in manifest['artifacts'] if x['path'] == relative), None)
            if record:
                assert len(data) == record['size'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == record['sha256']
            receipt = dest.with_name(dest.name + '.regional-receipt.json')
            if not receipt.exists():
                remote_uri = f'gs://marin-us-central2/ema-gram-20-reference-probes/seed0-r02-20261107/counter-18665/{uuid}/{relative}'
                save(dest.with_name(dest.name + '.regional-started.json'), dict(uri=remote_uri, expected=record))
                if client is None:
                    client = storage.Client()
                blob = client.bucket('marin-us-central2').blob(remote_uri.split('/', 3)[3])
                blob.reload()
                assert blob.size == len(data)
                if record:
                    assert int(blob.generation) == int(record['generation']) and blob.crc32c == record['crc32c']
                fetched = blob.download_as_bytes(if_generation_match=int(blob.generation), checksum='crc32c')
                assert fetched == data
                save(receipt, dict(uri=remote_uri, generation=int(blob.generation), size=len(data), sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), crc32c=blob.crc32c))
        print(json.dumps(dict(task=i, archive_size=len(p.read_bytes()), uuid=uuid, artifact_count=len(artifact_paths), regional_readback=True)), flush=True)

"""Offline exact-identity and scientific-output audit of four original probe attempts."""
import copy
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import math
import statistics
import subprocess
from collect_reference_r02_terminal import R, E, ROOT, START, C, SOURCE
from collect_reference_r02_startup import config_equal


def audit_report(report, checkpoint):
    assert report['checkpoint'] == checkpoint and report['step'] == 18665
    assert report['dataset'] == 'uncheatable_eval/wikipedia_english'
    assert report['batches'] == 8 and report['batch_offset'] == 0
    pairs = {(a, g) for a in (0, .125, .25, 1/3, .5) for g in ((.0001,) if a == 0 else (.0001, .01))}
    loss = report['loss_probes']
    decomp = report['decompositions']
    assert len(loss) == 27 and {(x['alpha'], x['ridge'], x['step_size']) for x in loss} == {(a, g, t) for a, g in pairs for t in (1e-5, 3e-5, 1e-4)}
    baseline = loss[0]['baseline_losses']
    for row in loss:
        assert row['baseline_losses'] == baseline and len(row['losses']) == len(baseline) == 8
        delta = [a-b for a, b in zip(row['losses'], baseline, strict=True)]
        assert all(math.isfinite(v) for v in baseline + row['losses'] + [row[k] for k in ('delta_mean', 'delta_std', 'delta_sem')])
        expected = dict(delta_mean=statistics.mean(delta), delta_std=statistics.stdev(delta), delta_sem=statistics.stdev(delta)/math.sqrt(8))
        for k, v in expected.items():
            assert math.isclose(row[k], v, rel_tol=1e-12, abs_tol=1e-15), (k, row[k], v)
    assert len(decomp) == 18 and {(x['category'], x['alpha'], x['ridge']) for x in decomp} == {(c, a, g) for c in ('attention', 'mlp') for a, g in pairs}
    for row in decomp:
        assert row['shape'] == {'attention': [1024, 1024], 'mlp': [4096, 1024]}[row['category']]
        assert row['path'] and set(row['seconds']) == {'newton_schulz', 'svd', 'gram_powers'}
        assert all(math.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in row['seconds'].values())
        assert math.isfinite(row['cosine']) and -1.000001 <= row['cosine'] <= 1.000001
        assert math.isfinite(row['relative_error']) and row['relative_error'] >= 0
    assert len(report['device_memory_stats']) == 4


def main():
    obs = json.loads((ROOT / 'canonical.json').read_text())
    job = obs['jobs']['0']['last_successful_snapshot']['job']
    assert obs['jobs']['0']['terminal'] and job['state'] == 'JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED'
    assert job['exit_code'] == job['failure_count'] == job['preemption_count'] == 0
    assert job['task_state_counts'] == {'succeeded': 4}
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=E, text=True).strip() == SOURCE
    startup = json.loads((START / 'validated.json').read_text())
    for path, digest in obs['binding']['inputs'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((E / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
    config_digest = obs['binding']['inputs']['logbooks/20-ema-gram-polar/reference-probes-r01-configs.json']
    config = json.loads((E / 'logbooks/20-ema-gram-polar/reference-probes-r01-configs.json').read_text())[0]['config']['train_config']
    checkpoint = config['trainer']['checkpointer']['base_path'].rstrip('/') + '/step-18664'
    hosts = []
    for i in range(4):
        directory = ROOT / f'task-{i}'
        task = json.loads((ROOT / f'task-{i}.json').read_text())['task']
        prior = startup['tasks'][i]
        assert task['task_id'] == prior['task_id'] and task['current_attempt_id'] == 0 and len(task['attempts']) == 1
        attempt = task['attempts'][0]
        assert task['state'] == attempt['state'] == 'TASK_STATE_SUCCEEDED'
        assert task['exit_code'] == attempt['exit_code'] == attempt['attempt_id'] == 0 and not attempt['is_worker_failure']
        assert attempt['attempt_uid'] == prior['attempts'][0]['attempt_uid'] and attempt['started_at'] == prior['attempts'][0]['started_at']
        expected = dict(task=task['task_id']+':0', attempt_uid=attempt['attempt_uid'], source_commit=SOURCE, configs_sha256=config_digest, checkpoint=checkpoint, expected_counter=18665, wrapper_sha256=hashlib.sha256((E / 'logbooks/20-ema-gram-polar/run_reference_probe.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
        identity = json.loads((directory / 'attempt.json').read_text())
        assert identity == expected
        manifest = json.loads((directory / 'upload-manifest.json').read_text())
        assert manifest['success'] is True
        assert {k: manifest[k] for k in expected} == expected
        archive = json.loads((directory / 'archive-receipt.json').read_text())
        assert archive['sha256'] == attempt['output_archive']['sha256'] == hashlib.sha256((directory / 'outputs.tar.zst').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        assert archive['size'] == len((directory / 'outputs.tar.zst').read_bytes()) and archive['generation'] > 0
        for artifact in manifest['artifacts']:
            data = (directory / artifact['path']).read_bytes()
            receipt = json.loads((directory / (artifact['path'] + '.regional-receipt.json')).read_text())
            assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == artifact['sha256'] == receipt['sha256']
            assert len(data) == artifact['size'] == receipt['size'] and int(artifact['generation']) == receipt['generation']
        join = startup['joins'][str(i)]
        native_id, host_id = join['native'][0], join['host'][0]
        native = json.loads((START / f'finished-native-{native_id}.json').read_text())
        assert native['id'] == native_id and native['state'] == 'finished' and native['summary']['probe/success'] == 1
        config_equal(native['config'], startup['runs'][native_id]['config'])
        for run_id in (native_id, host_id):
            cfg = json.loads((directory / run_id / 'config.json').read_text())
            config_equal(startup['runs'][run_id]['config'], cfg)
            config_equal(cfg['resolved_config'], config)
        host = startup['runs'][host_id]
        assert host['state'] == 'finished' and host['summary']['logging_check/success'] == host['summary']['probe/success'] == 1
        report = json.loads((directory / native_id / 'report.json').read_text())
        audit_report(report, checkpoint)
        lossrows = [json.loads(x) for x in (directory / native_id / 'loss-rows.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
        assert lossrows == report['loss_probes']
        last = lossrows[-1]
        for key in ('alpha', 'ridge', 'step_size', 'delta_mean', 'delta_sem'):
            assert native['summary']['probe/' + key] == last[key]
        assert native['summary']['_step'] == 27
        assert math.isclose(native['summary']['probe/baseline_loss_mean'], statistics.mean(last['baseline_losses']), abs_tol=1e-14)
        assert math.isclose(native['summary']['probe/loss_mean'], statistics.mean(last['losses']), abs_tol=1e-14)
        hosts.append(dict(task=task, worker_reconciliation=json.loads((ROOT / f'worker-{i}.json').read_text()), identity=identity, archive=archive, manifest=manifest, native=dict(id=native_id,url=native['url'],state=native['state'],summary=native['summary']), host_logging=dict(id=host_id, state=host['state'], cached_startup_reused=True), report=report))
    first = hosts[0]['report']
    for h in hosts[1:]:
        assert h['report']['loss_probes'] == first['loss_probes']
        for a, b in zip(h['report']['decompositions'], first['decompositions'], strict=True):
            assert {k:v for k,v in a.items() if k != 'seconds'} == {k:v for k,v in b.items() if k != 'seconds'}
    # Corrupt substantive fields to show the offline audit rejects invalid evidence.
    negative = []
    for name, mutate in [
        ('wrong_counter', lambda x: x.update(step=18666)),
        ('wrong_checkpoint', lambda x: x.update(checkpoint=checkpoint+'-wrong')),
        ('missing_loss_row', lambda x: x['loss_probes'].pop()),
        ('nonfinite_loss', lambda x: x['loss_probes'][0]['losses'].__setitem__(0, float('nan'))),
        ('wrong_paired_statistic', lambda x: x['loss_probes'][0].update(delta_sem=1.0)),
        ('missing_svd_row', lambda x: x['decompositions'].pop()),
        ('wrong_matrix_shape', lambda x: x['decompositions'][0].update(shape=[1,1])),
        ('invalid_cosine', lambda x: x['decompositions'][0].update(cosine=2.0)),
    ]:
        bad = copy.deepcopy(first)
        mutate(bad)
        try:
            audit_report(bad, checkpoint)
        except AssertionError:
            negative.append(name)
        else:
            raise AssertionError('Negative case passed: '+name)
    evidence = {str(p.relative_to(R)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ROOT.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name != 'verified.json'}
    value = dict(passed=True, verified_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(), source=SOURCE, canonical=obs['jobs']['0']['last_successful_snapshot'], hosts=hosts, checkpoint=checkpoint, counter=18665, loss_rows_per_host=27, decomposition_rows_per_host=18, paired_batches=8, paired_statistics_independently_recomputed=True, all_scientific_outputs_finite=True, four_host_loss_and_direction_diagnostics_exactly_equal=True, timing_and_device_memory_are_process_specific=True, negative_cases_rejected=negative, evidence=evidence, restore_scope='Actual full TrainerState load with allow_partial=False and stored counter18665 verified by frozen source and completed four-host probe. No independent all-57-array finiteness audit, optimizer update, data-position replay, or training-resume claim.', scientific_scope='Second of three preregistered alpha=.25 reference checkpoints only. Four hosts replicate the same eight paired batches and are not independent scientific samples. No final exponent selection or confirmation conclusion from this checkpoint alone.', observer_retired_naturally=True)
    assert subprocess.run(['ps', '-p', '27858', '-o', 'command='], capture_output=True, text=True).returncode != 0, 'Original observer must retire naturally before final cache'
    (ROOT / 'verified.json').write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n')
    dest = E / f'scratch/{C}-00-completion/verified.json'
    dest.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    dest.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n')
    (R / 'logbooks/20-ema-gram-polar/reference-probe-r02-completed.json').write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({k:value[k] for k in ('passed','counter','loss_rows_per_host','decomposition_rows_per_host','paired_batches','four_host_loss_and_direction_diagnostics_exactly_equal','negative_cases_rejected','restore_scope')}))
    print(json.dumps(dict(baseline_mean=statistics.mean(first['loss_probes'][0]['baseline_losses']), delta_range=[min(x['delta_mean'] for x in first['loss_probes']),max(x['delta_mean'] for x in first['loss_probes'])], cosine_range=[min(x['cosine'] for x in first['decompositions']),max(x['cosine'] for x in first['decompositions'])], relative_error_range=[min(x['relative_error'] for x in first['decompositions']),max(x['relative_error'] for x in first['decompositions'])])))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
